[Arm RULES

ABILITIES

Ammo Runts (Once per battle, per unit): In your Shooting phase,
when this unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability. If you
do, this unit's ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls.

Place any number of Ammo Runt tokens next to the unit, removing
them when this ability is used.

Tide of Muscle: In the Fight phase, if this unit made a charge move
this turn, this unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

EE EE

Never Too Busy to Fight: Being engaged does not prevent this unit
from being eligible to start an action.

UNIT COMPOSITION

= 1-2 Nob models
* 9-18 Boy models

Every Nob is equipped with: 1 Kustom Choppa; 1 Kombi-skorcha.
Every Boy is equipped with: 1 Choppa; 1 Shoota; 1 Slugga.

BE EE
